uutiset.t: Danamon’s Kawasaki Stays Bullish on Indonesia Growth
uutiset.s: Bank Danamon Indonesia President Director Nobuya Kawasaki says Indonesia’s economy remains resilient despite concerns over the country’s outlook, pointing to strong loan demand and consumer activity. uutiset.t: How Trump Is Approaching the Xi-Putin Trilateral
uutiset.s: Reporting live from Shenzhen, Bloomberg's Stephen Engle explains how US President Donald Trump has emphasized a stable relationship and personal rapport with Chinese President Xi Jinping ahead of their bilateral meeting at the APEC summit in Shenzhen. (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: French Risks Have Traders Betting Euro’s Slide Is Far From Over
uutiset.s: The euro’s tumble to an 18-month low shows few signs of easing, as expectations mount that next year’s election in a politically divided and fiscally stressed France will continue to weigh on the common currency.

uutiset.t: Anthropic Shares Indicated More Than 20% Higher on Gray Markets
uutiset.s: Anthropic PBC shares are indicated to open between 22% and 26% higher in gray market trading after the artificial intelligence lab’s upsized $107.3 billion initial public offering and private placement broke SpaceX’s record.

uutiset.t: New World Shares Tank 54% to Head for Worst Week on Rights Issue
uutiset.s: New World Development Co. shares are heading for their worst week on record as a heavily discounted rights issue shakes investor confidence, prompting analysts to downgrade the indebted Hong Kong developer.

uutiset.t: Anthropic IPO Raises $107.3B to Top SpaceX's Record Debut
uutiset.s: "Bloomberg: The Asia Trade" brings you everything you need to know to get ahead as the trading day begins in Asia. Bloomberg TV is live from Sydney with Haidi Stroud-Watts and Paul Allen, getting insight and analysis from newsmakers and industry leaders on the biggest stories shaping global markets.

uutiset.s: Bloomberg's Stephen Engle reports on China's plans to provide about $20 million for APEC cooperation, including a policy research center, signaling support for multilateralism across the 21-member group. uutiset.t: RRJ-Led Consortium Buys Australia Coal Miner’s $619 Million Debt
uutiset.s: A consortium led by private investment firm RRJ Capital has agreed to buy $619 million of bonds from Australian coking coal miner GM3, according to people familiar with the matter.

uutiset.t: India Studies Tax Proposals to Encourage Stock Trading, Curb Speculative Bets
uutiset.s: Investors and economists have proposed raising taxes on stock derivatives while lowering levies on share trading.

uutiset.t: K-Pop Giants Position for China Return After Decade-Long Freeze
uutiset.s: South Korean entertainment companies are positioning themselves for a return to China after the two countries agreed to expand cultural exchanges, raising hopes that Beijing may loosen restrictions that have kept major K-pop acts out of the mainland for almost a decade.

uutiset.t: Australian Dollar Erases 2026 Gain as Rate-Cut Bets Increase
uutiset.s: Australia’s dollar wiped out its 2026 gain against the greenback after weak employment data reinforced bets that the central bank has ended its interest-rate hike cycle and will pivot to cuts next year.

uutiset.t: Anthropic IPO Hands Korean Tycoon’s Firm $3 Billion Windfall
uutiset.s: Anthropic PBC’s blockbuster initial public offering has delivered a multibillion-dollar windfall for billionaire Chey Tae-won’s empire, rewarding an early bet on the artificial intelligence startup by SK Telecom Co., South Korea’s largest mobile carrier.

uutiset.t: Copper Rebounds After Rout as Physical Tightness Persists
uutiset.s: Copper steadied after plunging almost 6% on Wednesday — the biggest drop since April 2025 — on a sharp unwinding of bullish bets tied to artificial intelligence and US tariffs.

uutiset.t: China Markets $2 Billion of Dollar Bonds as Xi, Trump Meet
uutiset.s: China began marketing up to $2 billion of dollar-denominated sovereign bonds, as leaders of the world’s two largest economies are set to meet in Shenzhen.
